title: More Vanilla (With Tools)
description: A modpack which leans heavily into the vanilla aspects of the game, trying to enhance large amounts of the game without imposing on the original feel of the game
body: The project started with trying to make a pack which is fairly vanilla-esque, like adding better structures through things like Incidium, Luki's, and better vanilla QOL features like better render distance through Voxy, 3d items, Armour Hider, better HUDs, Sorting, crafting and performance. As the project was made to be played with friends on a variety of platforms (Windows and Mac), it has essential // e4mc so you can host your own local multiplayer worlds, whilst still being playable on laptops (without shaders, non low-end laptops should be able to run shaders with settings tweaked). Server core is added to the mod list to allow people hosting the world to have a more playable experience. Note, this is not needed on the non-host side. Separately, the pack has a variety of tools built into it to allow players to import builds via Litematica and see info for crafting through JEI and its extensions, as creative testing is commonly needed for builds.
